title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about with Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove stops suddenly. She's looking at a claw machine filled with little Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How foolish. As if I would want such a ridiculous thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: One of the younger students gave me a gift the other day. I merely thought it might make a good thank-you present.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She's a hard worker who is always aspiring to fulfill her dreams. She deserves a little something to brighten her days.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, there's no guarantee I can even win anything here… I'll have to consider other options.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oho, big words. Very well, I'll hold you to that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show me a performance worthy of the Empress's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
